notes: Standard Shopify Dawn theme. Stock is INVERTED but the badge selector is not stock-specific: '.card__badge .badge' can also render 'Nyhet' (new) or sale badges, not just 'Slutsåld' (sold out) — scraper must check the badge's text content equals 'Slutsåld' to mark out-of-stock, not just presence. Price text contains both price__regular and price__sale blocks; when not discounted both show the same value — take the price-item--sale value if present and non-empty, else price-item--regular. 17 in-stock + 5 sold-out products, 2 pages confirmed.
